scope: Three screens of one proposed flow, not alternative designs. No production implementation.

screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality Android mobile app UI, app content only, no phone bezel, no OS status bar or browser chrome. One focused screen, not a collage. Target logical viewport 390 x 844, portrait aspect ratio, rendered sharply. This is a Korean preview for Sobrita, a Mexican everyday budgeting and savings app. Current date anchor 2026-11-09; no calendar dates needed.
Reference image is a previous Sobrita design, style grounding only, not an edit target. Preserve navy typography, crisp rectangular outline controls, a tiny pixel-art coin jar, and teal actions; refine using actual project tokens: warm light cream #FBF5E9, surface #FFFDF7, navy #202848, muted #545E7E, teal #0E7A72, teal soft #D8EDEA. Body 14-16px equivalent, readable Korean sans-serif, subtle pixel flavor only in brand and tiny jar. Prefer whitespace, separators and flat surfaces. No gradients, no nested cards, no large shadows.
Concept name: Compact goal on an everyday budget home.
Show the HOME AFTER THE USER HAS SAVED A GOAL AND RECORDED MX$300 OF SAVINGS. The core budget UI must dominate; the product savings goal must take only about 100 logical px high, around 12% of the screen. Do not make the goal a large promotional banner or huge photo.
Exact visual content from top:
small pixel-style brand wordmark 'Sobrita', tiny outlined settings icon right.
A friendly medium heading '오늘도 조금씩, 여유롭게'.
Below a large flat budget section with label '이번 주 남은 생활비', prominent 'MX$1,850', small '주간 예산 MX$2,500'. A small teal button '지출 기록하기'.
Light horizontal divider.
Row '내 목표' at left with small teal text action '+ 목표 추가' right.
ONE compact outlined goal card: small realistic photo of white AirPods 4 earbuds and charging case, about 48x48. Text 'AirPods 4' and 'MX$300 / MX$1,499'. A thin teal progress bar exactly about 20% full. A short supporting line 'MX$1,199 더 모으면 돼요'. Small chevron on right. Entire card around 100px high. No button or illustration inside that increases the height.
Next section separated by whitespace: '최근 기록' with two tidy list rows: '장보기' / '− MX$180' and '커피' / '− MX$45', small neutral line icons.
Keep generous whitespace lower down and a tiny pixel coin jar no larger than 24px if space allows.
Bottom navigation with three small icons and labels '홈', '기록', '목표'; home selected in teal.
All Korean text accurately rendered. Amounts MX$300 and MX$1,499 are mock user-recorded progress and target, not an automatic bank balance. No live-price badges, no purchasing, no success popup. No titles or explanatory captions outside the app screen.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality Korean Android app UI, one focused screen, not a collage. App content only: no device frame, no OS status bar or browser chrome. Logical target dimensions 390 x 844 portrait; render sharp text, natural ratio. Current date anchor 2026-11-09, no visible dates.
Input reference is a prior Sobrita goal creation design, use as visual language grounding. Keep navy typography, crisp square navy outline fields, teal buttons, a tiny pixel coin jar. Use current palette warm cream #FBF5E9, offwhite #FFFDF7, navy #202848, teal #0E7A72, muted #545E7E. Korean sans serif body 14-16px equivalent. Flat surfaces, generous whitespace, no excessive cards or shadows, no gigantic product image.
Concept name: Review a product imported from a pasted shopping link.
This is the Sobrita goal creation screen AFTER a user pasted a Walmart Mexico product link and the app found the image and price. It shows how the imported data is confirmed before saving, with link still visible. All fields remain user-editable. No implication every retailer always imports successfully.
Header small 'Sobrita'. Back arrow and main title '링크로 목표 만들기'.
Supporting line '가져온 정보를 확인해 주세요'.
At top show a compact label '상품 링크', single outlined field 'walmart.com.mx/…' with a small '변경' text action.
Below, a neat horizontal product summary: realistic white AirPods 4 earbuds with charging case photo around 72x72. To its right small merchant name 'Walmart México', title 'AirPods 4', small link '상품 페이지 보기'. Under the summary, a small muted amber line '확인한 페이지에서 품절' (historical page state, not a universal stock warning). Keep product summary compact.
Then clear editable fields:
label '목표 이름', outlined field 'AirPods 4', tiny edit pencil.
label '목표 금액', bigger outlined field 'MX$1,499', tiny edit pencil.
Below two short readable helper lines '배송비를 포함해 바꿀 수 있어요.' and '가격은 자동으로 갱신되지 않아요.'
Light separator.
Section heading '저축 계획 (선택)'.
Compact row '이미 모은 금액' with outlined value 'MX$0'. Helper '따로 모아 둔 돈만 입력해 주세요.'
Compact row '목표 날짜' with value '나중에 설정' and calendar icon.
At bottom a single full-width teal CTA '목표 저장하기', followed by a small secondary text link '사진·금액 직접 입력하기'.
Do not add a successful saving toast, bank transfer, buy button, realtime price indicator, signup, notification or advertisement. Perfect legible Korean text and consistent monetary formats. No outside-screen captions.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one realistic production-quality Korean Android app UI screenshot, app content only, no device frame, no OS status bar or external browser chrome. Logical target dimensions 390 x 844 portrait, sharp readable text.
Concept name: Conditional shopping-site verification inside the app.
This is a PROPOSED Sobrita in-app browser fallback shown ONLY IF the retailer requests a human verification. It is not the default path, not evidence of a completed challenge, and not a live screenshot. Current date anchor 2026-11-09; no visible dates needed.
Input image 1 is Sobrita style reference, not a screen to copy literally. Native Sobrita chrome: warm cream #FBF5E9, navy #202848 type and outlines, muted #545E7E, teal #0E7A72 buttons. Readable Korean sans serif 14–16px equivalent, subtle pixel brand. Flat, generous whitespace, no decorative cards or big illustrations.
Input image 2 is a REAL EARLIER Walmart security-page screenshot. Use only the merchant webpage region as visual reference; REMOVE the diagnostic test-app text at the top entirely. Retain the merchant blue Walmart header, white content area, Spanish verification heading and explanation. Do not translate the actual retailer content into Korean. Do not invent a solved state, green check, loaded product, or bypass.
Native app header: back arrow and '상품 확인', close X at right.
Small domain row with lock icon and 'walmart.com.mx'.
Native pale cream helper strip above website: title '보안 확인이 필요한 경우' and supporting text '쇼핑몰의 확인을 직접 완료해 주세요.'
Below is an in-app merchant webpage, clearly separated by a thin navy divider: Walmart blue header with white Walmart wordmark and yellow spark matching reference. White content. Spanish main text 'Verifica tu identidad'. Smaller Spanish explanation 'Mantén presionado el botón para confirmar que no eres un robot.' Show a pale gray pill control as in the reference, empty and uncompleted, without any solving hand, instructions from Sobrita about the puzzle, or checkmark. This area should fill the middle of the screen naturally, with clear separation from native controls.
Native fixed bottom area, warm cream background and thin navy top divider. Small helper '상품 화면이 보이면 눌러 주세요.' One full-width teal primary button with exact Korean text '상품 정보 다시 읽기'. Below secondary text link '직접 입력하기'.
One small subdued note under secondary link, if space: '확인이 어려우면 직접 입력할 수 있어요.'
No purchase or sign-in button, no developer jargon, no diagnostic logs, no install-app promotion. Preserve clear visual ownership: the merchant's blue webpage in the middle, Sobrita's native cream navigation and teal actions outside. No captions outside the screen.
